mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.1% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as capital costs decline.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0%, aggressive monetary tightening increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in CPIAUCSL and PAYEMS indicate weakening consumer demand and labor market slack, triggering negative equity returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in CPIAUCSL and PAYEMS fails to produce negative returns in more than 50% of cases over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0%) creates policy stimulus room and reduces inflation expectations, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of high unemployment periods (UNRATE > 5.0%).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in INDPRO exceeding 1.0% signals supply chain contraction, reducing corporate profitability expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO declines > 1.0% monthly.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 1500.0 thousand units indicate weak residential demand, correlating with broader economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when HOUST < 1500.0.

mechanism_narrative: Rising FEDFUNDS combined with CPIAUCSL > 3.0% signals aggressive inflation-fighting policy, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations for negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of FEDFUNDS rising and CPIAUCSL > 3.0% fails to produce negative returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Post-pandemic GDP expansion (GDPC1 growth > 2.0% quarterly) signals robust economic demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days as earnings improve.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.0% quarterly.
